responsibility: Drives the main Fortran parser and compilation-unit state machine. It decodes statements, manages nested program-unit and block states, loads USE-associated modules, dispatches semantic resolution and code generation, and coordinates post-parse passes such as implicit-pure fixing, external-interface checks, and parse-tree or prototype dumping.
same_name_distinction: Implements the parser driver and compilation-unit state machine: statement decoding, state-stack management, USE loading, program-unit parsing, and coordination of later resolution/code-generation steps. Unlike gcc/fortran/parse.h, it executes parsing and orchestration rather than just defining parser states, stack records, and support declarations.
